Maya Chen: Morning — dropping a super-brief async standup for today. TL;DR: small rollout today, watch latency dashboards, need a quick CR review.

Leo Park: ✅ Yesterday: finished the QPS throttling prototype and ran smoke tests.
Leo Park: 🔁 Blockers: none. Need a quick sanity review on the config changes (PR #428).

Priya Singh: ✅ Yesterday: integrated the new KV-cache telemetry into the runtime agent.
Priya Singh: ⛔ Blockers: seeing one weird spike in tail-latency when sequence lengths > 1024. Adding extra logging now.

Sam Ortiz: ✅ Yesterday: landed the dedicated capacity autoscaler weights. Ran canary.
Sam Ortiz: 🔁 Today: monitoring throughput, will open a follow-up if the canary hits the corner case.

Alex Rivera: Heads-up — small hosted rollout scheduled 14:00 PST. I’ll trigger it and post updates. @Maya Chen can you give the green if critical?

Maya Chen: Yes, go ahead at 14:00. Keep fallback policy on. :thumbsup:

Jordan Blake: Quick ask — anyone available for a 15-min pairing on the prompt-regression test? I can do 15:30–16:00.
Jordan Blake: @Priya Singh?

Priya Singh: I can join 15:30. Will bring the failing prompt set.

Kim Yoon: ✅ Yesterday: addressed two small UX nits in the console deploy flow.
Kim Yoon: 🔁 Today: sync with design at 11:00 about rollout messaging copy.

Tina Opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service=inference-runtime, sha=3a1f9d. Tracking at https://console.redwood.local/deploys/3a1f9d

Maya Chen: Quick CR nudge — PR #428 (Leo) and #431 (Alex) would be great to get a quick glance. Nothing big, just config + docs.

Leo Park: Pinged reviewers: @Jordan Blake, @Alex Rivera — added a short changelog in the PR description.

Alex Rivera: Noted, will review before the 14:00 window.

Priya Singh: Update: added the extra KV logging; re-ran the long-seq test, latency spike still reproducible with a particular batching alignment. Posting logs in the thread in a sec.

Sam Ortiz: Canary looks stable so far — CPU and GPU tail-latency within expected. Will hold off on full rollout until afternoon check.

Maya Chen: Reminder — if you need any emergency rollback steps, the rollback runbook is pinned in #eng-sre.

Jordan Blake: CR review done for #428, left two tiny comments.

Leo Park: Thanks Jordan. Addressing comments now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy successful for inference-runtime sha=3a1f9d — observability OK.

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything pops up, call in #eng-oncall. Otherwise, quick wins today.

Alex Rivera: Quick FYI: I'll flip the full rollout flag at ~15:00 PST if no issues.

Priya Singh: Filed an issue for the long-seq latency root cause (INC-2024). Will attach the logs and playback.

Kim Yoon: Great — thanks team. :coffee:
